individuals.label: Tsalala founder female 1 (co-founder; kicked by zebra)
aliases: one of the "Two" in the Two and Seven Pride
individuals.birth_note: Adult in 1998; one of two Castleton Pride females who broke away.
individuals.fate: Kicked in the head by a zebra stallion and later died of her injuries (undated, between about 1999 and 2002).
individuals.mother_id_or_label: Castleton Pride (natal pride; mother not named)
offspring_labels: two-and-seven-cubs-1998 (shared litter of 7 with founder female 2; mother of each cub not specified)
individuals.notes: Legacy post never says which of the two founders was the mother of the Original Tailless Female; the one who survived (founder 2) is inferred to be her mother because she died in Dec 2002 when the Original Tailless was ~4 (Epic post).

individuals.label: Tsalala founder female 2 (mother of the Original Tailless Female)
individuals.birth_note: Adult in 1998; one of two Castleton Pride females who broke away.
individuals.fate: Old and slow; killed by hyenas in front of Tree Camp in December 2002 (Legacy).
individuals.mother_id_or_label: Castleton Pride (natal pride; mother not named)
offspring_labels: other cubs of the 1998 litter of 7
individuals.notes: Maternity of the Original Tailless inferred: the Epic post says the Original Tailless was left the only pride member when her mother died when she was 4; Legacy says the pride was reduced to "mother and daughter" before Dec 2002.

individuals.label: The seven cubs of the 1998 Castleton breakaway ("Two and Seven" litter)
individuals.birth_note: Denned in the Sand River near Taylor's Crossing; sired (believed) by the West Street Males.
individuals.fate: Three cubs killed in a clash with the Sparta Pride; a female cub killed by hyenas; a male cub died after his back was broken at a buffalo kill at Maidies Dam; a male was later found poached; one female (the Original Tailless Female) survived.
individuals.notes: Group entry. The 2021-05-04 post gives "four cubs" (one of which survived to be the Original Tailless) denned at Ximpalapala Koppie instead of seven near Taylor's Crossing - see open_questions.

individuals.label: Original Tailless Female
individuals.birth_note: Born 1998 (Epic post); sole surviving cub of the founding breakaway litter (Legacy).
individuals.fate: Mauled by the Mhangeni lionesses (her granddaughters) at a zebra carcass; remains found next day at Marthly Pools, 2013, aged ~15. Legacy states the mauling; 2018 posts say "suspected".
individuals.father_or_sire_label: West Street Males (believed, via the 1998 litter)
individuals.notes: Mated with the Marthly Males (2002). Lost her tail to hyenas in 2005 after a zebra kill (chewed off the stump), hence the name. Reached the Majingilane takeover (2010) as matriarch; took the surviving 2009 female cubs of her daughters away north and raised them (the future Mhangeni Pride) - the Epic post says these were probably her daughters' cubs, not her own. Rejoined the Tsalala Pride Oct-Nov 2011 and helped it kill a buffalo after the Nov 2011 hyena attack on her daughter. Legacy counts the Aug 2012 cub as her 12th.

other_reports.label: Original Tailless Female (Tsalala)
other_reports.birth_note: Born 1998 (2017-05-01); 'Two and Seven' pride formed by two Castleton breakaway females in 1998 (2021-12-07). Mother died when she was ~4.
other_reports.fate: Found dead at Marthly Pools in 2013 after being mauled while trying to feed at a Mhangeni pride zebra kill (2021-12-07 states Mhangeni females mauled her; 2018-05-20 says only 'suspected').
other_reports.mother_id_or_label: Unnamed adult female of the 'Two and Seven' pride (died ~2002, hyenas)
offspring_labels: Tsalala Sisters (b. Dec 2002, sired by Marthly Males)
Tailless female cubs born 2005, 2008 (four, sired by Mapogo), 2012 single cub (12th cub)
other_reports.notes: Lost her own tail to hyenas (2005). Took the surviving 2009-born granddaughters (daughters of the Tsalala Sisters) north in 2010-2011 and raised them to independence; these became the Mhangeni Pride. 2022-01-10: 'The Mhangeni Pride is the result of a heroic rescue of a set of cubs by their grandmother.' 2017-05-01 says the rescued cubs were 'actually her daughter's and not her own'. Primary coverage belongs to the Tsalala agent.

other_reports.label: Original Tailless Female (Tsalala)
other_reports.birth_note: Born 1998 to one of the two females who broke from the Castleton Pride (the 'Two and Seven' cubs); sole survivor of the seven.
other_reports.fate: Mauled by the Mhangeni lionesses (her granddaughters) at a zebra carcass in 2013; body found at Marthly Pools (suspected, 'mauled by the females').
other_reports.father_or_sire_label: West Street Males (father of the Two-and-Seven cubs)
offspring_labels: Tsalala Sisters (Tailed and New Tailless females, born Dec 2002)
Cubs of 2005-2012 incl. her 12th cub in Aug 2012
other_reports.notes: Lost her tail to hyenas in 2005. Led four 2009-born grand-daughters away from the Majingilane (2010); they became the Mhangeni Pride. Context only.

individuals.label: Tsalala Sister - the (New) Tailless Female
individuals.pride: Tsalala Pride, then Tsalala Breakaway Pride (2015-2018)
individuals.birth_note: Born December 2002 on Ximpalapala Koppie, twin of the Tailed Female; sired by the Marthly Males (Legacy).
individuals.fate: Found dead ~6 June 2018 at Marthly Pools within metres of where her mother died; had been found badly wounded on 30 May 2018; injuries believed inflicted by Ntsevu lionesses (inference by author).
offspring_labels: tsalala-cubs-2006 (shared with sister; mother of each cub not specified)
individuals.notes: Lost her tail to hyenas on 1 Nov 2011 (Legacy; the 2016-05-23 post says 2012). In Sept 2015 took the four 2013-born sub-adults (3 males, 1 female - her sister's litter) away from the Matimba Males, forming the Tsalala Breakaway Pride; rejoined pride briefly Aug 2017; after the Tailed Female's death in Feb 2018 was the last senior Tsalala female. Which Sister bore which 2011 litter is not stated; assignment (Feb 2011 litter = Tailed; May 2011 litter = Tailless) is inferred from the 2016-03-31, 2018-03-22 and Legacy posts. Nov 2016 post says a Matimba male was seen mating with "the tailless Tsalala lioness", contradicting the Epic post that only the two remaining (non-breakaway) females mated with the Matimbas.

individuals.label: Tsalala Sister - the Tailed Female
individuals.birth_note: Born December 2002 on Ximpalapala Koppie, twin of the Tailless Female; sired by the Marthly Males (Legacy).
individuals.fate: Carcass found 19 Feb 2018 just below Ximpalapala crest, aged ~15; had been skeletal and isolated from the pride for weeks and was left behind by her sister and the pride; cause unknown (hyenas or natural causes).
individuals.notes: Mated with the Rocky Male (2006 litter), Mapogo (2009 litter), Majingilane (2011, 2013 litters) and the Matimba Males (2016 litter) in turn. In Sept 2015 she (not the Tailless Female) stayed with the 2011 female while the Tailless Female took the Tsalala sub-adults away. Ximpalapala Koppie is where she denned multiple litters and where her carcass was found.

other_reports.label: Tsalala Sister: 'Tailed Female'
other_reports.birth_note: Born Dec 2002 at Ximpalapala Koppie, sired by the Marthly Males.
other_reports.fate: Died early 2018 near Ximpalapala Koppie after the Tsalala pride fed on a dead elephant; condition had been deteriorating at ~15.
offspring_labels: Two of the four 2009-born Mhangeni foundress lionesses (twin daughters of the sisters, Mapogo-sired)
other_reports.notes: Which sister mothered which 2009 cubs is not stated.

individuals.label: Tsalala Young Male (b. 2005)
individuals.birth_note: Son of the Original Tailless Female (from her 2005 litter of 2 males + 2 females); survived the hyena incident that cost her her tail.
individuals.fate: Forced to flee the Mapogo (c. 2007-08); joined the Sparta Pride; in 2010 "an impressive specimen" but unable to cement a place without a coalition. 2019 post recalls him on a rhino kill south of Londolozi with Sparta males. Later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: Legacy: "At three years old the other surviving sub-adult male ... had the choice to either stay or flee and flee he did" (so ~2008).

individuals.label: Original Tailless Female's 2005 litter - other cubs (2 females, 1 male)
individuals.birth_note: Litter of four (2 M, 2 F) about six months old when their mother lost her tail in 2005.
individuals.fate: Two female cubs did not survive (Epic: lost to starvation while mother could not hunt); one young male was killed by the Shaw's Males.
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Rocky Male
individuals.pride: Territorial male over the Tsalala Pride (c. 2006)
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Caught, killed and eaten by the Mapogo Males in early 2007 (Legacy: "very unusual behaviour").
individuals.notes: Sire of the Tsalala Sisters' first litters (April 2006).

individuals.label: Tsalala Sisters' first litters (April 2006; six cubs)
individuals.birth_note: Born April 2006 on Ximpalapala Koppie, to the two Tsalala Sisters at age 3.5 (6 cubs total).
individuals.fate: Mapogo Males killed all but two cubs; one female disappeared, was assumed dead, but surfaced in the Castleton Pride (see tsalala-castleton-queen-female-2006).
individuals.mother_id_or_label: tsalala-sister-tailless and tsalala-sister-tailed (split of cubs between them not stated)
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Castleton Pride female "Queen" (Tsalala-born, 2006)
individuals.birth_note: One of the Tsalala Sisters' 2006 cubs; thought dead after the Mapogo takeover but joined the Castleton Pride.
individuals.fate: Alive in late 2011 (identified by her reddish eyes); later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: Legacy: "Unbeknown to her they were distant relatives. For five years, Londolozi were unaware of this change in pride until late 2011".

individuals.label: Original Tailless Female's 2008 litter (2 males, 2 females)
individuals.birth_note: Born early 2008 after the Tailless Female separated from the pride.
individuals.fate: Killed by the Majingilane Males in 2010 (Legacy: two killed quickly, two more later; Epic: four Tsalala cubs killed). Identification of the victims as exactly this litter is inferred.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Mapogo Males (inferred - Legacy credits the Mapogo with the pride's growth)
individuals.notes: Group entry. Legacy counts 2 male + 2 female cubs (2008) and 4 female cubs (2009).

individuals.label: Mhangeni Pride original lionesses (four sisters/cousins born 2009)
individuals.birth_note: Four female cubs born 2009, two to each Tsalala Sister, fathered by the Mapogo Males (Kinky-tail and Satan per Legacy).
individuals.fate: Raised from sub-adulthood by the Original Tailless Female; formed the Mhangeni Pride (2012). Two still alive in 2024, aged ~15; one had lost her teeth.
individuals.mother_id_or_label: tsalala-sister-tailless / tsalala-sister-tailed (two cubs each; which is which not stated)
individuals.notes: Group entry. Also called the "Mhangeni breakaway" lionesses in 2012-13. Their own mothers abandoned them for the Majingilane in 2010. 2018-05-30 and Legacy say the Original Tailless died after a mauling by the Mhangeni lionesses ("her granddaughters").

individuals.label: Mhangeni Lioness (b. 2009) who paired with the Tsalala Female in 2022
individuals.birth_note: Born in the Tsalala Pride in 2009 to one of the Tsalala Sisters, sired by the Mapogo Males.
individuals.fate: Left the Mhangeni Pride after mating with the Plains Camp Males (cubs lost); paired with the Tsalala Female Aug-Sept 2022, then rejoined the Mhangeni Pride, believed pregnant (Nov 2022).
individuals.mother_id_or_label: one of the Tsalala Sisters (not specified)
individuals.notes: The blog calls her the Tsalala Female's "great aunt"; by the stated pedigree she would be an aunt (if her mother was the Tailed Sister, who bore the Tsalala Female's mother) or a first cousin once removed (if her mother was the Tailless Sister) - the label is not consistent; see open_questions.

individuals.label: Tsalala 2011 Female
individuals.birth_note: Born early February 2011 (Legacy) - sole survivor of the eight 2011 cubs; sired by the Majingilane Males.
individuals.fate: Last confirmed Sept/Oct 2017; reported missing with a cub after a squabble with other lions (presumed Majingilane); presumed dead. Not seen again; Legacy: "an altercation with some males ... The 2011 Female had gone missing".
individuals.notes: Accepted by the Majingilane Males (her fathers) as she matured. Her 2016 litter was sired by the Matimba Males (Legacy / Epic) though a 2018 post allows Majingilane as possible sire for later cubs. Maternity inferred from "the older tailed female and her daughter from 2011" (2016-03-31).

individuals.label: Tsalala cubs of 2011 (other than the 2011 Female)
individuals.birth_note: Two litters: early Feb 2011 (3 F + 1 M) and 29 May 2011 (3 M + 1 F); sired by the Majingilane Males. Eight cubs in total including the 2011 Female.
individuals.fate: Two May-litter males killed hunting buffalo (autumn 2011); the five-month-old May male (who survived 10 days alone in Nov 2011) was killed 26 Dec 2011 by the Scar-Nose Majingilane male; a Feb-litter male and female swept away in the Jan 2012 flood; two further females gone before May 2012.
individuals.notes: Group entry. The Feb 2011 litter is described as "the second female's"; first Sister's earlier litter failed (probably killed by Majingilane).

individuals.label: Original Tailless Female's single cub (2012)
individuals.birth_note: Born August 2012 (her 12th cub per Legacy); father not stated.
individuals.fate: Disappeared at ~4 months old.
individuals.notes: Photo caption in 2018-02-20 post: "born to her mother, the old Tailless female, but never made it to adulthood".

individuals.label: Tsalala Female (2013 litter) - mother of the 2019 cub
individuals.pride: Tsalala Pride (last adult); Tsalala Breakaway Pride (2015-2018)
individuals.birth_note: Born winter 2013 in a cave on a koppie by the Manyelethi (Southern Cross Koppies); only female of a litter of four (3 M + 1 F). Legacy tables and the 2022-09-19 post say 2014.
individuals.fate: Found dead 20 Nov 2021 in the Sand River in the western Sabi Sand, near full term pregnancy; bite marks on her neck - killed by male lions (Plains Camp Males believed responsible per 2023-12-11).
individuals.notes: All four cubs of her litter reached independence. Went with the Tailless Female (aunt) in the 2015 breakaway; became the sole surviving Tsalala female after June 2018; mated with a Birmingham male (Oct and Dec 2018) and gave birth in March 2019 on the koppie where she herself was born; killed a buffalo alone in July 2019; was attacked by the Ntsevu Pride and a Birmingham male in May 2020 but escaped; mated with the Tumbela Males in Aug 2021.

individuals.label: Tsalala Males (three brothers of the 2013 litter)
individuals.birth_note: Three male cubs of the Tailed Female's 2013 litter, sired by the Majingilane Males.
individuals.fate: Dispersed as a nomadic trio (last seen on Londolozi Aug 2018; 2019 post says they went south, probably into Kruger). Legacy says they were electrocuted in the Kruger National Park feeding on a giraffe touching power lines, dating it after Aug 2017 - conflicts with 2018 sightings.
individuals.notes: Group entry for three unidentified brothers; individual males are not distinguished. Returned briefly May and Aug 2018 (killed a zebra on 2018-08-21).

individuals.label: Tsalala cubs of March 2016 (Tailed Female's litter of 2)
individuals.birth_note: Born March 2016 in the Manyelethi riverbed, sired by the Matimba Males; Legacy says two female cubs.
individuals.fate: All Matimba-sired cubs died by early 2018 (the "5 cubs ... none survived"); several lost Sept-Oct 2017 after a clash with other lions; fate of each not documented.
individuals.notes: Group entry. 2017-10-30 mentions "1 older male" among the youngsters, whereas Legacy lists all five 2016 cubs as females.

individuals.label: Tsalala cubs of June 2016 (2011 Female's litter of 3)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~early June 2016 near Marthly Pools to the 2011 Female (her first litter); Legacy: three female cubs; sire Matimba Males.
individuals.fate: All lost by early 2018; the 2011 Female and a young female cub went missing Oct 2017 and the remaining cubs "never made it".
individuals.notes: Group entry. Combined with the March 2016 litter the pride had five cubs in Oct 2016.

individuals.label: Tsalala Breakaway cubs of 2017 (Tailless Female's litter)
individuals.birth_note: Born March 2017 on Ximpalapala Koppie (3 cubs per Legacy, 2 by April); sire unclear - Matimba or Majingilane.
individuals.fate: One died very young; one lost at ~8 months (Oct 2017, possibly killed by other lions); the last (a male) was emaciated and not expected to live in May 2018 - death not confirmed.
individuals.notes: Group entry. 2018-05-07 states "Only one Tsalala cub is still alive".

individuals.label: Tsalala sub-adult killed by a Birmingham male in 2017
individuals.birth_note: Identity not stated; a Tsalala sub-adult (probably one of the 2016 cubs).
individuals.fate: Killed in 2017 by a Birmingham male (the blog later says the same male searched for the Tsalala female in Sept 2018).
individuals.notes: Single throwaway sentence in 2018-09-17: "it is the same male who killed the Tsalala sub-adult last year". Identity inferred only.

individuals.label: Tsalala Female (b. March 2019) - the last Tsalala lioness
individuals.birth_note: Born first week of March 2019 in the cave on Southern Cross Koppies where her mother was born; one of three cubs (1 M + 2 F); father a Birmingham male.
individuals.fate: Alive at last mention (Feb 2026). Mother killed Nov 2021; has since raised no surviving cubs (3 in 2024, lost Oct-Nov 2024; litter of late Sept 2025 lost within a week; possible new den Feb 2026 unconfirmed).
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Birmingham Males - "a Birmingham male" (2019-12-12); the male with the hanging dreadlock who visited her is the likely sire (inferred)
individuals.notes: Escaped an attack by the Ntsevu Pride and a Birmingham male with her mother in May 2020; solitary from Nov 2021; paired with the Mhangeni Lioness (Aug-Sept 2022); mated with the Skorro Young Male (Nov 2023), the Plains Camp Males (Dec 2023-Feb 2024; Jan 2025), the Kruger Male (May 2025) and both Gijima Males (Nov 2025). Denned 2024 on rocks west of Londolozi.

other_reports.label: Tsalala Female (born March 2019)
other_reports.birth_note: Born March 2019 (litter of three: one male, two females; 'exactly four years old' on 2023-03-27); mother killed 20 Nov 2021
other_reports.fate: Alive Nov 2025 (looked for a mate, second litter lost late 2025).
sibling_labels: Two sisters killed by leopard Aug 2019
other_reports.notes: Mating partners listed in posts: Skorro Male (Nov 2023), Plains Camp Males (Dec 2023-Feb 2024; Jan 2025; sired her 2024 and Sept 2025 litters), Kruger Male (May 2025), both Gijima Males (Nov 2025). Primary coverage belongs to the Tsalala agent.

individuals.label: Tsalala cubs of March 2019 - the two siblings of the Tsalala Female
individuals.birth_note: Litter of three born ~first week of March 2019 (1 M + 2 F per Legacy); the Tsalala Female is the survivor.
individuals.fate: Aug 2019: attacked by a (suspected) male leopard; at least one confirmed killed (Legacy: two killed a month after July 2019). The remaining cub was a female.
individuals.notes: Group entry (one male, one female).

individuals.label: Tsalala Female's 2024 cubs (2 females, 1 male)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~May 2024 in a rocky outcrop west of Londolozi (reported with a litter of three from early July 2024); sired (almost certainly) by the Plains Camp Males.
individuals.fate: One female lost late Oct/early Nov 2024 after an encounter with nomads (Kruger Male + Southern Avoca Male); the other two lost days later after an altercation with the Ximungwe Pride; Jan 2025 post suggests the smaller Plains Camp male as possible killer.
individuals.notes: Group entry. The 2024-11-05 post says "one of the female cubs" died first and a female and a male remained.

individuals.label: Tsalala Female's late-September 2025 litter
individuals.birth_note: Second litter, born late Sept 2025 on a koppie on Singita; litter size unknown; sire presumed Plains Camp Male (her mating partner) - not confirmed.
individuals.fate: Moved to a new den after a week and not seen again; no suckle marks on 20 Nov 2025 - presumed lost.
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Scar-Nose Majingilane male
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Fate not individually stated; the whole coalition was "entirely deceased" by May 2018.
individuals.notes: Killed a 5-month-old Tsalala cub on 26 Dec 2011 (Legacy).

individuals.label: Dark-maned Majingilane male
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Fate not individually stated.
individuals.notes: Almost always the first to mate with an oestrus female (2019-05-07).

individuals.label: Hip-scarred Majingilane male
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Fate not individually stated.

individuals.label: Majingilane male with the missing canine
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Fate not individually stated.

individuals.label: Fifth Majingilane male (killed by the Mapogo, June 2010)
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Isolated and killed by the Mapogo Males with a spine-breaking bite, June 2010 (Legacy).
individuals.notes: Only the Legacy post says the coalition arrived as five and lost one to the Mapogo; other posts speak of four fully grown males from 2014 onwards.

individuals.label: Dark-maned Matimba male ("Hairy Belly")
individuals.birth_note: Unknown; one of an original coalition of six Matimba males.
individuals.fate: Left Londolozi Jan-Feb 2017 (Orpen Gate); returned to the western Sabi Sand by May 2018; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: First Matimba seen on Londolozi (2 Sept 2015, "Hairy Bellied Matimba"). The blog treats "dark-maned", "hairy belly" and "enormous mane" as the same male - inferred; the lighter male is also called "ginger-maned" and "blonder".

individuals.label: Light/ginger-maned Matimba male
individuals.birth_note: Unknown.
individuals.fate: Survived a near-fatal attack by unidentified males in Feb 2016 (kill bite near the spine) and recovered; left Londolozi Jan-Feb 2017; seen at Ximpalapala Koppie in 2018.
individuals.notes: The "blonder" Matimba male that went missing 8-20 Feb 2016; attacker(s) unknown (Birmingham males suspected by the author).

individuals.label: Birmingham male (sixth brother) lost before the coalition reached Londolozi
individuals.birth_note: One of six brothers born ~2010 (the 2020 post gives six; 2020-09-12 says born in 2010).
individuals.fate: Killed in a dispute with older, more experienced lions, before the coalition was first seen in the NE Sabi Sand (date approximate).
individuals.notes: Posts disagree on the original size: six (2020-03-02, 2021-06-22) vs five on arrival (2022-08-03, 2020-09-12).

individuals.label: Birmingham male who left north shortly after arrival (never seen again)
individuals.birth_note: One of the five/four Birmingham males.
individuals.fate: Left a few months after the coalition's arrival and moved north; never seen again (so far the coalition went five -> four).
individuals.notes: The 2020-03-02 (written 2018) post instead attributes the drop from five to four to a fight at a white rhino carcass ("searching for the one responsible for the death of their sibling").

individuals.label: Birmingham male who died before siring the 2019 Ntsevu litters (injured male)
individuals.birth_note: One of the Birmingham brothers.
individuals.fate: Described as "in a bad way" (Aug 2019); the 2019-08-15 post says the male who died was gone before the current Ntsevu litters; only two Birmingham males remained by Dec 2019.
individuals.notes: Identification of the "injured Birmingham male" (2019-09-05) with this death is inferred.

individuals.label: Birmingham male with the hanging dreadlock (most impressive male)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2010.
individuals.fate: Unclear which of the last two Birmingham males he was; one fell to / fled the Ndzhenga Males in 2021-22.
individuals.notes: Repeatedly visited the Tsalala female; blog identifies "a Birmingham male" as the father of her cub (Dec 2019). Whether he is the same male who killed a Tsalala sub-adult in 2017 is not stated.

individuals.label: Birmingham male that fell to the Ndzhenga arrival (Nov 2021)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2010.
individuals.fate: One of the two remaining Birmingham males; "fell to the arrival of the Ndzhenga Males (assumption no fact)".
individuals.notes: Contradictory framing: 2022-04-11 says one Birmingham male fell and the other fled; 2022-11-10 says the coalition had "dwindled to one".

individuals.label: Last surviving Birmingham male
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2010 (coalition born 2010 per 2020-09-12).
individuals.fate: Pushed out by the Ndzhenga Males in Nov 2021-2022, fled to the western Sabi Sand, teamed with the Nkuhuma Male; referred to as "late" by Sept 2023. Cause/date of death not stated.
individuals.notes: Also called the "Birmingham Male" in 2022 posts.

individuals.label: Mapogo male "Kinky-tail"
individuals.birth_note: Mapogo: three males born 2000 and three born 2002.
individuals.fate: Pinned down by the Majingilane in June 2010 (Satan tried to defend him); outcome not stated.
individuals.notes: One of the two Mapogo males that stayed on Londolozi with the Tsalala Pride (2008-2010).

individuals.label: Mapogo male "Satan"
individuals.birth_note: Mapogo: three males born 2000 and three born 2002.
individuals.fate: Fled the Majingilane night of June 2010 calling to his brothers; later fate not stated.

individuals.label: Old Sparta lioness (littermate of the Mapogo)
individuals.birth_note: Born in the Sparta Pride; a littermate of the Mapogo males.
individuals.fate: Died 2013 (cause not stated); a great huntress.
individuals.notes: After her death three adult Sparta females (two sisters and their cousin) raised 7 cubs under the Majingilane.

individuals.label: Two Sparta lionesses born 2007 (cubs of the last Shaw's male)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2007 to the Sparta lionesses; sired by the Shaw's males' sole survivor.
individuals.fate: Still adult Sparta females in 2015; one killed in 2017 by the Ntsevu (Mhangeni breakaway) lionesses; Sparta pride down to one female by Nov 2020.
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Last surviving Shaw's male
individuals.birth_note: One of five males born in the late 1990s.
individuals.fate: Survived the Mapogo for 3 years; euthanised in poor condition in Mala Mala in January 2010.

individuals.label: Sparta lioness killed by the Ntsevu (Mar-Apr 2017)
individuals.birth_note: Not stated; mother of two 14-month-old cubs.
individuals.fate: Killed by the six Mhangeni Breakaway (Ntsevu) lionesses in a clash south-east of Londolozi, witnessed by Umkumbe guides.
individuals.notes: Evidence stated in 2017-04-03; 2017-07-03 repeats it.

other_reports.label: Sparta lioness killed by the Mhangeni breakaway lionesses (Mar 2017)
other_reports.fate: Killed ~end March 2017 in a clash unseen by Londolozi staff, by the six Mhangeni breakaway (later Ntsevu) lionesses.

individuals.label: Sparta cubs of 2016 (sired by the Matshipiri Males)
individuals.birth_note: Two Sparta lionesses each birthed two cubs in early 2016.
individuals.fate: One male cub killed by the Mantimahle coalition (mid-2017); others not accounted for.
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Sparta young male who joined the Mhangeni breakaways (2015)
individuals.birth_note: One of three Sparta males born 2012, sired by the Majingilane.
individuals.fate: Joined the Mhangeni breakaways Sept-Oct 2015, then disappeared; two brothers dispersed south east; none seen again.
individuals.notes: Earlier tried to join the Tsalala Pride and was not accepted (Sept 2015).

individuals.label: Ntsevu Pride original six lionesses (born 2013)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2013, daughters of the Mhangeni lionesses and the Majingilane Males (first batch of nine cubs, six of which became these lionesses).
individuals.fate: By 2023 two of the six had died (unknown circumstances); the rest are split between the Ntsevu and Kambula prides.
sibling_labels: three Mhangeni males of the same litter (the "Mhangeni males")
individuals.notes: Group entry. Named Ntsevu ("six" in Shangaan) in April 2017; Mala Mala calls them Kambula.

individuals.label: Mhangeni Pride second batch (12 cubs, 2015-16)
individuals.birth_note: Collectively 12 cubs (9 M + 3 F per 2018-09-29) born Oct 2015 - mid 2016 to the four Mhangeni lionesses.
individuals.fate: Pushed out by the end of 2017; fragmented; some died.
individuals.notes: Group entry; only included for the Majingilane lineage.

individuals.label: Ntsevu (Mhangeni breakaway) first cubs, 2016-17
individuals.birth_note: Early cubs of the Mhangeni breakaway lionesses; sire the Matimba (believed) and/or Matshipiri Males.
individuals.fate: No further sightings; none survived.
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Ntsevu cubs of 2018 - first Birmingham-sired litters that failed
individuals.birth_note: Litters of early 2018 (incl. 3 cubs found 2018-04-28 that vanished within a week).
individuals.fate: One litter killed by the very males that sired them (Birmingham) and another by a female within the pride (2018-09-09).
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Ntsevu cubs born 2018-19 sired by the Birmingham Males (the "12 subadults")
individuals.pride: Ntsevu Pride -> Ntsevu Breakaway Pride / Kambula Pride
individuals.birth_note: Born Aug 2018 - mid 2019 (6 males + 6 females per later posts; 13 cubs reported in Jan 2019; "presumably 15 cubs, 11 seen" in Nov 2019).
individuals.fate: After the Ndzhenga takeover (Nov 2021) the sub-adults fled; 4 females rejoined mothers by 2022; 2 males went to Kruger; 4 males + 1 female formed the Ntsevu Breakaway Pride.
individuals.notes: Group entry; counts vary between posts (see open_questions).

individuals.label: Ntsevu Young Males (Ntsevu Breakaway Males; later called Kambula Males)
individuals.birth_note: Six males of the 2018-19 Birmingham-sired cohort; later four males (3 b. 2018, 1 b. 2019).
individuals.fate: Two moved into Kruger; four roamed the SW with one sister; moved north in 2024 where they clashed with the Plains Camp Males; "Ntsevu Males ... back together" Jan 2025.
individuals.notes: Group entry. In Nov 2024 the "Kambula Males (Ntsevu breakaway Males)" are the Birmingham-sired males; in 2025-07 "Kambula sub-adult males" are a different, Ndzhenga-sired group.

individuals.label: Ntsevu Breakaway female (the 'Kambula Breakaway lioness')
individuals.fate: Alive Apr 2026, paired with the Styx Male.
individuals.notes: Separated from brothers by Oct 2024; companion of the Styx Male (Oct 2024-Apr 2026) hunting buffalo; 2025-06-12 and 2025-08-17 call her the 'Kambula Breakaway Lioness'. No cubs reported.

other_reports.label: Ntsevu Breakaway female (b. 2019)
other_reports.birth_note: The only female among the breakaway males; Birmingham-sired.
other_reports.fate: Left her brothers in 2024; paired with the Styx Young Male (Oct 2024) and the "Kambula Breakaway Lioness" is likely the same lioness (2025-06-12) - unconfirmed.

individuals.label: Ntsevu cubs of April / October 2021 (Birmingham-sired)
individuals.birth_note: April 2021: litter of 5 (found 7 Apr 2021); Oct 2021: more litters; 11 cubs in total at Dec 2021-Mar 2022.
individuals.fate: 7 of 11 lost after the Ndzhenga arrival (Nov 2021); 4 survivors Mar 2022; 2 left by Aug 2022.
individuals.notes: 2022-04-11: 'last four cubs of the Birmingham Coalition'; 2022-08-03: youngest lost, another lost, 2 left. 2022-01-10 describes April-born cubs of 5 with only 3 left; dating of litters differs among posts.

other_reports.label: Ntsevu cubs of 2021 - the last Birmingham-sired cubs
other_reports.pride: Ntsevu Pride / "Ntsevu Two plus Two" breakaway
other_reports.birth_note: Eleven cubs of mixed litters alive in Nov 2021 (one litter of 5 born April 2021; others Aug-Oct 2021).
other_reports.fate: Seven of eleven lost within weeks of the Ndzhenga arrival; four remained March 2022; two by Aug 2022. Later fate not stated.
other_reports.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Nkuhuma Male (Nkumati Coalition)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2016 (2021-01-09: ~4 years old 'born 2016'; 7 years old in Sept 2023, 8 in 2024)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026 (Nkumati Coalition, south-west Londolozi). Survived Ntsevu Breakaway attack (2023) and Plains Camp/Gijima encounters (2025).
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Birmingham Males (stated 2022-08-10: 'either his son or nephew' of the last Birmingham male; 2023-09-04: 'his late father, the Birmingham Male')
individuals.notes: Left the Nkuhuma Pride and paired with the Styx young male (b.2016) by 2020-21; Styx partner 'mysteriously died'. Teamed in 2022 with the last Birmingham Male after Ndzhenga takeover; scarred right eyelid (2026-04-02), scar from altercation with his Birmingham father. Briefly paired with Skorro Male Jan 2024; formed coalition with the Talamati Male from mid/late 2024 ('together since mid-2024', 2026-02-12); named Nkumati (2026-02-09).

other_reports.label: Nkuhuma Male (son of the Birmingham Males)
other_reports.birth_note: Aged 7 in Sept 2023 -> ~2016; 'sired by the Birmingham Males, either son or nephew' (2022-08-10); 'late father, the Birmingham Male' (2023-09-04).
other_reports.fate: Alive, in the Nkumati Coalition with the Talamati Male (since 2024).
other_reports.notes: Side branch of the Birmingham lineage; the surviving Birmingham Male teamed with him in 2022.

other_reports.label: Nkuhuma Male (son or nephew of the Birmingham males)
other_reports.birth_note: Born ~2016 (7 yrs in Aug 2023); sired by the Birmingham Males.
other_reports.fate: Alive 2026; partner of the Talamati Male as the Nkumati coalition.
other_reports.father_or_sire_label: Birmingham Males (son or nephew; "late father, the Birmingham Male" in 2023)
other_reports.notes: Scar across the right eye from a fight with the last Birmingham male.

individuals.label: Othawa Male (also written Ottawa)
individuals.birth_note: Born early 2015 (2021-01-09: five year old Othawa male); 2018-09-17 says 3.5 yrs; 2019-12-02 inconsistently says 'about seven years old'.
individuals.fate: Died 2021. Posts say he was killed by the Birmingham Males after pushing too far east into their territory (2024-08-05, 2024-08-26); in Jun 2021 the Birmingham Males had 'triumphed over' him (2021-06-22); a deceased male is photographed by Sept 2021 (2021-09-20).
offspring_labels: Mhangeni cubs of 2020-21 (one survivor in Aug 2022)
individuals.notes: Lone male, joined Mhangeni pride Dec 2019, mated with Ntsevu lioness Mar 2020 (2020-03-24). Dominant over south-west/west Londolozi. Contradictions: age in Dec 2019; cause of death (see fate).

other_reports.label: Othawa (Ottawa) Male
other_reports.birth_note: Born early 2015 (2021-01-09: 'five-year-old', 'born early 2015'; 2018-09-17: 3.5 years); 2019-12-02 wrongly says ~7.
other_reports.fate: Killed by the Birmingham Males after pushing too far east into their territory in 2021 (Jun-Nov 2021).
other_reports.notes: Lone male; joined the Mhangeni Pride Dec 2019; mated with an Ntsevu lioness Mar 2020; clashed with the Birmingham Males Jun 2021. 'Previously dominant over the western section' (2021-06-22).

other_reports.label: Othawa Male
other_reports.fate: Killed by the Birmingham Males after pushing too far east into their territory (2021).
other_reports.notes: Dominant over the Mhangeni Pride 2020-21; his territory then taken by the Plains Camp Males.

individuals.label: Skorro (Breakaway) Young Male
individuals.birth_note: Sired by the Orpen Males, themselves sired by the Matimba Males.
individuals.fate: Alive 2024; mated with the Tsalala Female Nov 2023.
individuals.notes: Matimba-line grandson (stated).

individuals.label: Talamati young male who joined Mhangeni Breakaways (2016)
individuals.birth_note: Young male in 2016; one of three Talamati males 'pushed into independence' (2016-04-02) and separated from his brothers in a fight with the Charleston males.
individuals.fate: Travelled with the Mhangeni breakaway sub-adults Aug-Sept 2016; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: 2016-08-20: 'the Matimba males (who are his fathers and the only reason he hasn't been driven off by them)'. Not clearly the same as the later Talamati young males (b.2019).

other_reports.label: Talamati young male with the Mhangeni breakaways (2016)
other_reports.notes: Separated from his brothers by the Charleston males; tolerated by the Matimba and shadowed the breakaway females.

other_reports.label: Talamati young male who tagged along with the Mhangeni breakaways (2016)

individuals.label: Nkuhuma lionesses "Ridge Nose" and "Amber Eyes"
individuals.birth_note: Born ~Dec 2012; sired by the Matimba Males.
individuals.fate: Killed in 2024, presumably by the Mhangeni Pride.
individuals.notes: Group entry.

individuals.label: Kruger Male (Kruger/S Avoca coalition)
individuals.birth_note: Born late 2013 or early 2014 in the S30 Pride near Skukuza (2024-11-04)
individuals.fate: Alive in May 2025 (mating with the Tsalala Female, 2025-05-25).
sibling_labels: Two S30 brothers (one lost 2016, one died 2021 of hip injury)
individuals.notes: Driven back to a nomadic life by the Mantimahle males after his last brother died (2021). Dark-edged mane. Not seen with the Southern Avoca Male after Dec 2024. Not to be confused with the earlier 'Kruger Male' of 2006 mentioned in 2015-12-14.

other_reports.label: Kruger Male (nomad partner of the Southern Avoca Male, 2024-25)
other_reports.birth_note: Born late 2013/early 2014 in the S30 Pride near Skukuza.
other_reports.fate: Mated with the Tsalala Female in May 2025; also suspected of killing a Tsalala cub (Oct 2024).

individuals.label: Tsalala Sister: 'New Tailless Female'
individuals.birth_note: Born Dec 2002; lost her tail to hyenas on 1 Nov 2011.
individuals.fate: Seriously injured ~May 2018 by the Ntsevu lionesses (her great-nieces / 'granddaughters' in the blog's wording); died at Marthly Pools within metres of where her mother died (per 2021-12-07).
offspring_labels: Two of the four 2009-born Mhangeni foundress lionesses (twin daughters of the sisters, Mapogo-sired)
individuals.notes: 2018-05-30 says she is the Tailed female's sister and that her injuries came from the Ntsevu lionesses, 'her granddaughters' (consistent with Ntsevu = daughters of the Mhangeni foundresses, who are daughters of the two Tsalala Sisters).

individuals.label: Original Mhangeni lionesses (four founders)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2009 (2021-12-07, 2022-09-19, 2024-06-10); conflicting 'born in 2008, eleven years old' in 2019-12-02. Two female cubs each from the two Tsalala Sisters.
individuals.fate: Fate of the individuals not stated: 4 adults in 2015-16, 3 adults in 2018-19, two 'original' lionesses (15 yrs, one toothless) still alive Jun 2024; 2026-02-12 lists no 2009-born adult.
offspring_labels: Mhangeni 2013 litter (9 cubs; 6 became Ntsevu founding lionesses)
sibling_labels: Group entry: four sisters/cousins; Tsalala Female (b.2019) is a great-niece of one of them
individuals.notes: Four females raised by their grandmother (Original Tailless Female) after the Majingilane takeover; produced all successive Mhangeni litters. 2019-12-02: 'three' adults; 2024-06-10: 'two lionesses were born into the original Mhangeni Pride in 2009'.

other_reports.label: Mhangeni foundress lionesses (4 originals, born 2009)
other_reports.birth_note: Born 2009 at Ximpalapala/Southern Cross area to the two Tsalala Sisters (two cubs each), sired by the Mapogo Males.
other_reports.fate: Still alive in 2024 (two oldest, ~15 yrs, one toothless); some deaths over time (3 adults by Dec 2019, 2 originals by 2022-24).
offspring_labels: First Mhangeni litter (2013): 6 daughters (= Ntsevu founding lionesses) + 3 sons (Mhangeni males 2013)
Second litter 2015/16: 12 cubs (9M/3F), sired by the Majingilane
Later litters sired by Matimba/Birmingham/Othawa/Plains Camp/Nkumati
other_reports.notes: Number of surviving founders: 4 adults (2015), 3 adults (2018-19, said to be '11 years old', born 2008 per 2019-12-02), 2 original lionesses in 2022-24 (aged ~15). Mated with Majingilane (2013), Birmingham (2018), Othawa Male (2019-21), Plains Camp (2021+). One original female left the pride in 2022 and briefly paired with the lone Tsalala Female.

individuals.label: Mhangeni 2013 litter males (three brothers of the Ntsevu lionesses)
individuals.birth_note: 2013 litter (inferred from 'nine sub-adults ... three males, six females', 2016-08-20/2016-09-05)
individuals.fate: Split from the breakaway lionesses between Aug and Dec 2016; subsequently 'consigned to obscurity' (2018-09-06). Fate unknown.
individuals.notes: Described as under pressure from the Matimba males to leave the young females (2016-08-20). Possibly some of the males that later disappeared into Kruger; no identification made.

other_reports.label: Mhangeni males of the 2013 litter (three brothers of the Ntsevu lionesses)
aliases: Three young males of the Mhangeni breakaways
other_reports.birth_note: Born 2013 in the first Mhangeni litter.
other_reports.fate: Unknown; left with / after the sisters ~2016; 'went obscure' (2018-09-06). One Talamati male and a Sparta young male associated with them briefly.
other_reports.notes: 'Three young males had split off' from the six breakaway females in late 2016.

individuals.label: Sparta young male who joined the Mhangeni (2015)
individuals.birth_note: One of the three Sparta males of 2012 chased by the Majingilane on 16 Jul 2015.
individuals.fate: Disappeared from the Mhangeni breakaways in late 2015 (fate unknown).
individuals.notes: Attached to the Mhangeni, then to the Mhangeni breakaways.

individuals.label: Ntsevu founding lionesses (6, born 2013)
individuals.birth_note: Born Sept 2013 (first Mhangeni litter of 9-10 cubs; 6 females + 3 males survived).
individuals.fate: Two original lionesses lost in early/mid-2023 (unknown circumstances); 4 originals by mid-2023: 3 in Ntsevu Pride + 1 in Kambula Pride; at least one barren.
individuals.notes: Independent from ~2015-16; named Ntsevu 2017. Individuals are not named; identified as 'the lioness at the back with pale fur and ridge on her nose' etc.

individuals.label: Ntsevu lioness suspected infertile / 'barren' lioness
individuals.birth_note: One of the founding six.
individuals.fate: Alive in Aug 2024 as the 'barren godmother' of the Ntsevu cubs.
individuals.notes: 2019-11/2020-03 posts: not pregnant despite repeated Birmingham mating; mated with the Othawa Male Mar 2020. 2020-08-18 reported she may have given birth to two cubs; 2024-08-15 says she has 'never been able to fall pregnant' - contradiction.

individuals.label: Ntsevu mothers who fled north in 2021 ('Ntsevu Two plus Two')
individuals.birth_note: Two of the founding six.
individuals.fate: Became the core of the new smaller 'Ntsevu Pride' (3 originals) by Mar 2024.
offspring_labels: The last 4 Birmingham-sired cubs of Oct 2021 (2 survivors by mid-2022)
individuals.notes: Fled the Ndzhenga arrival from Oct 2021 and came back 24 Mar 2022 with 4 cubs; 3 originals formed the Ntsevu faction.

individuals.label: Kambula Pride's lone 2013-born lioness (eldest; mentor to the sub-adults)
individuals.birth_note: One of the 2013 founding Ntsevu females.
individuals.fate: Alive Mar 2026; left with 11 sub-adults towards Kruger NP (Nov 2025).
individuals.notes: 2025-07-14: 'one of the founding lionesses was born in 2013, the others are from a 2018 litter.' 2025-08-19 / 2025-11-19: fifth lioness stayed with sub-adults as matriarch. Identity with the 2013-born lioness is inferred.

individuals.label: Two Ntsevu founding lionesses lost in 2023
individuals.birth_note: Two of the six founders.
individuals.fate: Died / lost in the first half of 2023 for unknown reasons (2023-07-19: one mother of 4 cubs and one with 5 cubs 'died').
individuals.notes: 2023-06-19 says two 2013 lionesses lost at 'beginning of 2023'; 2024-03-21 says 'mid-2023'.

individuals.label: Ntsevu lioness with two daughters who bit her sister's cub (2023)
individuals.birth_note: One of the original six.
individuals.fate: Alive 2023.
individuals.notes: Kept cubs separate from the pride for months; seriously wounded a cub of her sister's litter (cub missing afterwards). A younger female seen with her may be a daughter from an earlier litter (inferred).

individuals.label: Early Ntsevu litters (2017-2018) - all failed
individuals.birth_note: Litters in early 2017, Jan 2018, Apr 2018 (3 cubs).
individuals.fate: No survivors: one litter killed by its sires (Birmingham), one killed by a female within the pride, others vanished.
individuals.notes: 2018-09-09: 'One litter was killed by the very males that sired them (Birmingham), and another litter was killed by a female within the pride.'

individuals.label: Ntsevu 2018 sub-adults / cubs (first successful litters)
individuals.birth_note: Born from ~Aug 2018 (litters of 3,3,5 and others; 15 cubs presumed, 11 seen by Nov 2019; counts vary); sired by the Birmingham Males.
individuals.fate: 11-12 survived to sub-adulthood (6 male, 5-6 female); later split into the Breakaway males and the Kambula daughters.
individuals.mother_id_or_label: Ntsevu founding lionesses (5 of 6 gave birth)
offspring_labels: Two older young males in Kruger NP

individuals.label: Ntsevu Breakaway Males (4): the Ntsevu / Kambula Males
individuals.birth_note: Three born 2018 and one male (with the female) born 2019 (2023-09-04).
individuals.fate: Alive Aug 2025; roaming north/south-east; one (largest) injured Nov 2024 and rejoined Jan 2025.
individuals.notes: Alias Kambula Males (Oct 2024-Jul 2025). Mated with Nkuhuma Pride lionesses in the north (Sept 2024).

individuals.label: Two older Ntsevu young males (went to Kruger NP)
individuals.birth_note: Oldest of the 6 males.
individuals.fate: Moved to / between Kruger NP and Sabi Sand by Aug 2022; two in Kruger by mid-2023.
individuals.notes: 'Oldest young male spending time in Kruger; second oldest bouncing between Kruger and Sabi Sands.'

individuals.label: Kambula daughters (born 2018): 4-5 adult lionesses of the Kambula Pride
individuals.birth_note: Born mid-2018, Birmingham-sired; rejoined their mothers in 2022.
individuals.fate: Alive 2026; two raising Ndzhenga-sired cubs, two Gijima-sired.
individuals.notes: Count disagrees: 2024-03-21 'five female offspring'; 2024-04-11 five lionesses in total; 2025-01-21 'four females from the same litter'; 2025-07-14 one 2013-born + 2018 litter = five adult lionesses.

individuals.label: Ntsevu litter of four (June 2019)
individuals.birth_note: Born June 2019; late litter.
individuals.fate: Presumably part of the sub-adults; one male + the female later in the breakaway group.
individuals.notes: 2019-11-23: 'a late litter of four cubs born in June 2019'; inferred that the 2019-born male and female of the breakaway group derive from it.

individuals.label: Ntsevu newest cub (Aug-Oct 2020)
individuals.birth_note: Less than 8 weeks old on 22 Oct 2020; also 'two cubs' reported Aug 2020.
individuals.fate: Unknown.
individuals.notes: May be the child of the formerly 'infertile' lioness.

individuals.label: Last two surviving Birmingham-sired Ntsevu cubs (2021 litter)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~Oct 2021 (partly).
individuals.fate: Still with 'Ntsevu Two' in Nov 2022; one sub-adult in 2024 caption 'two remaining youngsters'.
individuals.notes: Names unspecified.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga-sired Ntsevu/Kambula cubs of Nov 2022 - Apr 2023 (the 'Kambula sub-adults')
individuals.birth_note: 21-24 cubs born Nov 2022 - Apr 2023 (litters of 3, 5, etc.); eight Ntsevu lionesses gave birth; 12 left by Jul 2023 (>=5 F, 8 M?), 13 cubs in Apr 2024 and 12 sub-adults (8M/4F) in Feb 2025; 11 (7M/4F) by Jul 2025.
individuals.fate: 11 sub-adults travelled with the eldest lioness into the Kruger NP side in late 2025; one young male killed by the Gijima Males in Nov 2025 (counts contradictory).
individuals.notes: Count details: 2023-06-19 '21 cubs...12 remain'; 2023-07-19 '24 cubs...12 to 16 remain; at least five F and eight M'; 2024-04-11 '13 cubs'; 2025-02-20 '12 subadults, 8M 4F'; 2025-07-14 '11 sub-adults, 7M 4F'.

individuals.label: Kambula sub-adult male killed by Gijima Males
individuals.birth_note: Born mid-2022 to early 2023.
individuals.fate: Killed by the Gijima Males during their takeover (autumn 2025); 'caught by surprise'.
individuals.notes: The blog still lists 7 males after the death, so the count conflicts.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga-sired Ntsevu Pride cubs (Nov 2023 trio; May 2024 four)
individuals.birth_note: Trio (1M,2F) born Nov 2023 (2024-08-15) or early Aug 2023 (2023-12-17, first seen Oct 2023); four (1M,3F) born May 2024.
individuals.fate: Four-cub litter lost (Apr 2025); trio ~1y4m old in Apr 2025 and 'three cubs' accompanying the Ntsevu Pride north in Nov 2025.
individuals.notes: Born in northern Mala Mala/Sand River. A sub-adult male with the 3 lionesses in Jun 2026 may be the Nov 2023 male (inferred).

individuals.label: Six Ndzhenga-sired Kambula cubs of 2025 (litters of 4 and 2)
individuals.birth_note: Four cubs (3M,1F) born ~early Feb 2025 in thickets on the Maxabene near the Sand River confluence; second litter of two later in 2025 (six cubs total).
individuals.fate: All 6 still alive as of 30 Dec 2025 and ~1 year old in Apr 2026 (one report 5 cubs on 31 Dec 2025).
individuals.notes: 2025-03-12 confirmed '3 males and 1 female' of the four.

individuals.label: Kambula cubs of Nov 2025 (Gijima-sired)
individuals.birth_note: Four cubs found 14 Nov 2025 (a few days old), second pregnant lioness probably also gave birth.
individuals.fate: Litter lost to the dark-maned Gijima Male by 28 Dec 2025 (infanticide); other litter status unclear.
individuals.notes: Disagreement: 2025-12-28 says 'one Kambula female lost her litter to dark-maned Gijima male'; 2026-04-04 says both lost their newest cubs.

individuals.label: Kambula cubs of April 2026 (Gijima-sired, 8 cubs)
individuals.birth_note: One cub ~10 days old seen 12 Apr 2026; eight cubs from two lionesses by Jul-Aug 2026.
individuals.fate: All eight alive Aug 2026.
individuals.notes: Dens shared on the Sand River.

individuals.label: Kambula lioness pair that stayed behind / mated with Gijima Males
individuals.birth_note: Probably the 2018 daughters.
individuals.fate: Alive Aug 2026.
offspring_labels: Apr 2026 cubs (8 with the other pair)
individuals.notes: They hung back when the others followed the Ndzhenga Males north.

individuals.label: Kambula lioness pair with the six Ndzhenga-sired cubs
individuals.birth_note: Probably the 2018 daughters.
individuals.fate: Alive 2026.
individuals.notes: Followed the Ndzhenga Males north to avoid Gijima Males.

individuals.label: Msuthlu adult lionesses (4)
individuals.birth_note: Not stated.
individuals.fate: 3 seen most Apr 2026, 4 again Sep 2026; 4th and one subadult seen further south.
individuals.notes: Pride described as 'formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride'. A sub-adult was killed by the Nkhulu Males late 2025.

individuals.label: Msuthlu sub-adults / young (11-14 lions in total incl. adults)
individuals.birth_note: Offspring of the four adults, sired by the Gijima Males; e.g. 2 sub-adult males, 2 young sub-adult females, 3 younger cubs seen Apr 2026.
individuals.fate: A young male harassed by the Nwaswitshaka Males in Aug-Sep 2026 - fate unknown.
individuals.notes: 2026-09-01: roughly seven sub-adults remain.

individuals.label: Styx Male (young, blonde)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2021 (2026-07-07) to a Styx Pride lioness and one of the Ndzhenga Males.
individuals.fate: Alive Sep 2026, nomadic.
individuals.notes: Pairs with the Ntsevu breakaway female Oct 2024-2026. Injured a Kambula male and killed a cub in Feb 2025; chased off by his father. Possible coalition partner for Nkuhuma Breakaway Male. The 2026-09-05 post 'The Styx Male: A Growing Presence' is not in the local corpus.

individuals.label: Styx Young Male (b. 2016) - Nkuhuma partner
individuals.birth_note: Born 2016; broke out of the Styx Pride and teamed with an Nkuhuma young male (2021).
individuals.fate: Mysteriously died (by 2021/22).
individuals.notes: Distinct from the 2021-born Styx Male.

individuals.label: Styx Pride lionesses (3 adults + 11 cubs, 2022)
individuals.birth_note: Not stated.
individuals.fate: Seen in the south of Londolozi; 3 young cubs in the Marula tree/airstrip 2023.
offspring_labels: Cubs killed by six nomadic males (Dec 2022)
individuals.notes: Ndzhenga-sired litters ran 2021-22; one cub killed by six new males Dec 2022.

individuals.label: Last adult Southern Pride lioness (April 2021)
individuals.birth_note: Not stated.
individuals.fate: Alive, raising two cubs (2021); 2025 offspring sired by Gijima.
offspring_labels: New offspring 2025 sired by Gijima Males
individuals.notes: A sub-adult female with her was injured and not expected to survive.

individuals.label: Last Othawa Male cub (b. 2021, Mhangeni Pride)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2021.
individuals.fate: Alive Aug 2022 and Jun 2024 (the 2021-born pride member).
individuals.notes: Sex not given.

individuals.label: Tsalala Sisters (Tailed Female and New Tailless Female)
individuals.birth_note: Both born December 2002 on Ximpalapala Koppie to the Original Tailless Female, sired by the Marthly Males (2021-12-07).
individuals.fate: Group entry. Tailed Female died early 2018 (aged ~15, after an elephant carcass feeding); New Tailless Female died May-June 2018 after an injury attributed to the Ntsevu lionesses (Tsalala agent).
offspring_labels: Original Mhangeni lionesses (four founders, 2 each, sired by Mapogo, b. 2009)
individuals.notes: Each sister bore two female cubs in 2009 sired by the Mapogo Males, which became the four founders of the Mhangeni Pride. 2022-09-19 describes the 2009-born Mhangeni female as the Tsalala Female's great aunt.

individuals.label: Mhangeni lioness born 2009 who mated with Plains Camp Males (2022)
individuals.birth_note: 'This lioness was born in 2009 and is now almost 14 years old' (2022-09-19)
individuals.fate: Rejoined the Mhangeni Pride by Nov 2022, believed pregnant; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: Left pride in mid-2022 after Plains Camp Males killed cubs not sired by them (per 2022-09-19), then paired with the lone Tsalala Female for ~2 months (Aug-Sept 2022); 2022-11-21: she fed on an impala without sharing and 'rejoined the Mhangeni Pride'. 2022-09-19: Tsalala Female's great aunt. Identity as one of the four founders is stated ('formed the core of the pride').

individuals.label: Mhangeni first litter (born 2013): 9 cubs (6 females + 3 males)
individuals.birth_note: Ntsevu females 'born in 2013' (2019-11-23); first Mhangeni batch first seen Sept 2013 with nine cubs (a tenth disappeared early).
individuals.fate: Six females became the Ntsevu Pride (renamed 2017-04-29). Three males split off Aug-Dec 2016; one Talamati male joined them in 2016. Males 'went that way' into obscurity (2018-09-06).
sibling_labels: Group entry; the 3 males were 'brothers to the Ntsevu lionesses'
individuals.notes: 9 of 10 raised to independence ('9 out of 10 on their first try (6 of which became the Ntsevu pride)' 2018-11-08). Sub-adults were pushed out as mothers began mating again. 2016-08-20: 3 young males under pressure from Matimba males; two lionesses pregnant by Oct 2016.

individuals.label: Ntsevu founding lionesses (six, formerly Mhangeni Breakaways)
individuals.fate: Link entry only; see Ntsevu agent. By 2023 two of the original six had died (2023 'unknown circumstances'); pride split into Ntsevu (3 originals) and Kambula (2024).
individuals.notes: Named Ntsevu on 2017-04-29 (Shangaan 'six'). Killed a Sparta lioness in Mar-Apr 2017 (2017-04-03). Mated with Matimba, Matshipiri, Majingilane (2017-11-06), Birmingham.

individuals.label: Mhangeni second big litter (late Oct 2015-mid 2016): 12 cubs (9 males, 3 females)
individuals.birth_note: Born between late October 2015 and mid-2016 (2018-09-29); the 2016-09-03 post reports '12 cubs between them' at ~age months.
individuals.fate: Pushed out by their mothers around end of 2017; fragmented, some died, some trailed the pride (2018-09-29). Two survivors are adult lionesses born 2016 (2026-02-12).
sibling_labels: Group entry; includes the two 2016-born adult females of 2026
individuals.notes: Mhangeni adults were seen mating with Birmingham males in Feb 2018 as they pushed these sub-adults away (2018-02-27). 'Mhangeni females collectively gave birth to 12 cubs' - sub-adults numbered 16 mouths with the adults.

individuals.label: Mhangeni lioness born 2018 (sired by Birmingham Males)
individuals.birth_note: 2026-02-12: 'one adult female born in 2018, sired by the Birmingham Males'. Likely from the litter of four seen Sept 2018 (inferred).
individuals.fate: Alive Feb 2026; gave birth to four cubs in Nov 2025.
individuals.notes: Cubs of Nov 2025 presumed sired by Nkumati Coalition (2026-07-07: 'The Nkumati coalition, having sired offspring with the Mhangeni pride'; the 2026-02-12 text does not name the sire explicitly). Linked to the 2018 litter by inference only.

individuals.label: Mhangeni cubs of Othawa Male's tenure (2020-21)
individuals.birth_note: Two cubs reported Aug 2020; a third cub carried by mother Dec 2020 (6-8 weeks old); 'last remaining cub from the Othawa Male's reign born in 2021' (2022-08-10). Year of birth inconsistent (2020 vs 2021).
individuals.fate: Only one survived to Aug 2022; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: 2020-12-29 describes a pride of adult lionesses, cubs and the Othawa Male. After the Othawa Male's death (2021) the Plains Camp Males moved in and 'killed off any offspring not sired by them' (2022-09-19).

individuals.label: Mhangeni cubs sired by Plains Camp Males (2023): nine cubs; three subadults by 2026
individuals.birth_note: Nine cubs reported Sept 2023 (2023-09-04); ten cubs Jun 2024 (2024-06-10); Feb 2026: two subadult females and one subadult male (2026-02-12).
individuals.fate: Survivors by 2026: two females, one male (subadults). Jul 2026: three subadults ~2.5 yrs old hunting with one experienced lioness (2026-07-16).
individuals.notes: Hippo carcass sighting Jun 2024 with five lionesses and ten cubs. Cub counts differ between posts (9 vs 10 vs 3 survivors).

individuals.label: Mhangeni cubs born Nov 2025 (four)
individuals.birth_note: Born November 2025 to a 2018-born lioness (2026-02-12)
individuals.fate: Alive and healthy, first brought to a kill Jan 2026.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Nkumati Coalition (Nkuhuma Male + Talamati Male) - implied
individuals.notes: The other two Mhangeni lionesses were also mating with the Nkumati males (2026-02-12). Paternity is implied, not stated outright in the Feb 2026 post; 2026-07-07 states the coalition 'sired offspring with the Mhangeni pride'.

individuals.label: Sparta young male who joined Mhangeni pride (2015)
individuals.birth_note: One of the Sparta males born 2012 (2018-09-06); pushed out with his two brothers by the Majingilane on 16 Jul 2015.
individuals.fate: Joined Mhangeni pride Sept 2015 (14th lion counted 12 Sep 2015), then 'was with them one day and the next he was not' (2018-09-06). A 2019 post recalls him 'for a few weeks' with the then Mhangeni Breakaway. Fate unknown; possibly seen near Skukuza.
individuals.notes: Earlier tried to join the Tsalala pride. Cross-agent link (Sparta).

individuals.label: Plains Camp Male (larger)
individuals.birth_note: ~5 years old Sept 2021 (2021-09-20) => born ~2016 (inferred); 'at the age of eight years' for one male in Sept 2024 (2024-09-11)
individuals.fate: Alive as of Nov 2025 (roaring near Ximpalapala Crest). 'Possibly the largest male lion in the Sabi Sand' (2024-04-22).
individuals.notes: Scar across his eye from a clash with the Southern Avoca Male (2025-01-16). Dominant of the pair in mating (2024-04-22). An unnamed Plains Camp Male limped with a back-leg injury after Aug 2025 clashes with Gijima Males (2025-08-17).

individuals.label: Plains Camp Male (smaller, very dark mane)
individuals.birth_note: Same age as brother (~5 in 2021)
individuals.fate: Alive as of Nov 2025.
individuals.notes: 2025-01-16: 'the smaller of the two Plains Camp Males' is the possible culprit in killing the three Tsalala cubs (Nov 2024) - inferred only; neighbours say both visited the cubs without aggression (2024-11-11).

individuals.label: Talamati Male (Nkumati Coalition)
individuals.birth_note: One of two 'sub-adult males' among the nine cubs born early 2019 (2022-07-25) - identity with the 2024 'Talamati Male' is inferred
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Northern Avoca Males (stated for the 2019 litter, 2022-07-25)
sibling_labels: Talamati cohort females (4) and a 2021-dead male
individuals.notes: Stood his ground (the Nkuhuma Male fled) when the Plains Camp Males attacked the pair on 21 Jun 2025 as they mated with a Ntsevu lioness (2025-06-22). Unrelated to Nkuhuma Male ('not brothers').

individuals.label: Talamati Male (died 2024)
individuals.birth_note: As above (inferred from the two young Talamati males, 2023)
individuals.fate: Died by end of 2024 - cause not stated ('after the unfortunate death of one of the Talamati Males', 2024-10-29).
individuals.notes: Dec 2023 tension: both young Talamati males survived an attack by the Ntsevu Breakaways in mid-2023 (2023-09-04).

individuals.label: Styx Male (born 2016, Styx/Nkuhuma pair)
individuals.fate: Died 'mysteriously'; the 2021 partnership with the Nkuhuma Male was short-lived after his death (2024-10-29). Year of death not given (after Apr 2021).
individuals.notes: Do not confuse with 'Styx Male (born 2021)'. Cross-agent link.

individuals.label: Styx Male (born 2021, son of an Ndzhenga male)
individuals.birth_note: 'a son of the Ndzhenga males, born in 2021' (2026-07-07)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026 as lone nomad; blonde mane.
individuals.notes: Fought a Kambula male Feb 2025 (killed a young cub, seriously injured an older male) then chased off by his father (2025-02-20). Association with a Kambula/Ntsevu breakaway female for ~2 years (2026-04-02). Gijima Males displaced him from buffalo kill (2025-06-12). Possible coalition partner for the Nkuhuma Breakaway Male (2025-08-04; 2026-07-07).

individuals.label: Skorro Male (Skorro Young Male / Skorro Breakaway Male)
individuals.birth_note: Young adult in 2023; sire's line only
individuals.fate: Last confirmed Jan-Feb 2024; Feb 2026 post notes an unidentified large male at Ximpalapala not Plains Camp (may be him, unknown).
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Orpen Males (born of Nkuhuma Pride, sired by Matimba Males)
individuals.notes: Mated with the Tsalala Female in Nov 2023 (2023-12-11); 2024-02-19 suggested he could be sire of her litter, but 2024-05-28 and 2024-09-03 say the Plains Camp Males are believed to be the fathers. Briefly paired with the Nkuhuma Male (Jan 2024). Lineage: 2023-08-07.

individuals.label: Dark-maned Northern Avoca Male
individuals.birth_note: Born in the Avoca Pride, Timbavati, after the Southern Avoca brothers (b. early 2013): 'younger three brothers' (2024-11-04)
individuals.fate: Not individually dated; one Northern Avoca Male was the last survivor by Dec 2022 and was still alive Jul 2024.
individuals.notes: Separated from his two brothers c.2019/20 and associated 'strictly' with the Talamati lionesses; has a bump/wrist injury in the front right foot (2022-07-25). Whether the single 'Northern Avoca Male' with the Nkuhuma Pride in Jul 2024 is this male is not stated.

individuals.label: Old Avoca Male (the Giraffe Male)
individuals.birth_note: Unknown
individuals.fate: Unknown
offspring_labels: Five male cubs born early 2013 in the Avoca Pride: two became the Southern Avoca Males, three the Northern Avoca Males
individuals.notes: Described as 'the legendary Old Avoca Male, also known as the Giraffe Male' (2024-11-04).

individuals.label: Southern Avoca Male (Kruger/S Avoca coalition)
individuals.birth_note: Born early 2013 in the Avoca Pride of the Timbavati, one of five male cubs (2024-11-04)
individuals.fate: Injured in a clash with the Plains Camp Males c.Nov 2024 and fled north; reappeared weak in the south weeks later (2025-01-16); no later sighting in these posts.
sibling_labels: Southern Avoca brother (killed by Nkuhlu Males)
individuals.notes: Held the Sparta and Sand River Prides with his brother; killed the Piva male leopard and Xidulu female leopard in 2017 (2024-11-04). Lower right canine broken.

individuals.label: Gijima Male (dark-maned, larger)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2016-2017 in the Greater Kruger (2026-07-07)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; 'carrying numerous injuries' (2026-07-07).
offspring_labels: Kambula lioness litters (killed late 2025; 8 cubs by Jul 2026)
individuals.notes: Mated with the Tsalala Female (Nov 2025). The Kambula female's 2025 litter was killed by 'the dark-maned Gijima Male' (2025-12-28).

individuals.label: Gijima Male (blonde / light-maned)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; beaten up by the Nkuhuma Breakaway Male ('badly battered' next morning, 2026-07-07).
individuals.notes: Mated with a Ntsevu lioness (Nov 2025) and both Kambula lionesses (Dec 2025). Crossed the Sand River to confront the Nkuhuma Breakaway Male.

individuals.label: Gijima Male (third brother, deceased)
individuals.birth_note: Same cohort as the two surviving Gijima males (inferred)
individuals.fate: Killed by the four Ndzhenga Males in an altercation in the deep south 'just months after' their Nov 2021 arrival (2025-08-21). Contradicts 2023-06-19, which has the Gijima Males injuring an Ndzhenga male in April 2022.
individuals.notes: Only evidence is the 2025-08-21 sentence; no other post counts three Gijima males.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male with side injury (name-giver)
individuals.birth_note: Three of the four males born 2015 (2022-11-10)
individuals.fate: Died 25 May 2023 - body found on Londolozi's eastern boundary; presumed succumbed to old buffalo-horn belly wound (2023-06-19).
sibling_labels: Two N'waswitshaka brothers in the coalition (larger & smaller injury-free males)
individuals.notes: 'Ndzhenga' means thorn in the side, after his buffalo-horn gash with protruding intestine.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male from S79 Pride (crooked front left paw)
individuals.birth_note: Unknown (born in S79 Pride, Kruger NP); the three N'waswitshaka males were born 2015
individuals.fate: Died 9 Feb 2023: body found east of the Sand River after a hind-leg injury sustained when caught alone by the Gijima Males (April 2022). 2022-12-14 describes a dislocated back-right knee.
individuals.notes: Front left foot fused at ~45 degrees; unrelated, joined the others during nomadic phase near Skukuza. Unable to keep up with brothers after the injury.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male (larger, dark mane, injury-free)
individuals.birth_note: One of three N'waswitshaka males born 2015
individuals.fate: Alive; displaced north by Gijima Males (Nov 2025); Jul 2026 two Ndzhenga males 'from the south' on Londolozi.
offspring_labels: Styx Male (b.2021) - one Ndzhenga male named father
individuals.notes: Largest of the four; 2022-05-18 describes 'the two strongest; one a lot larger than the other and with a darker mane'.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male (smaller, injury-free)
individuals.birth_note: One of three N'waswitshaka males born 2015
individuals.fate: Alive; front-paw injury after clash with Black Dam Males Jul 2023 (2023-08-07).
individuals.notes: 2022-12-14: the Ntsevu females are somewhat bigger than him.

individuals.label: Ridge Nose (Nkuhuma Breakaway lioness)
individuals.birth_note: Born around December 2012, littermate of Amber Eyes, sired by Matimba Males (2022-08-10; 2024-07-31)
individuals.fate: Killed in 2024 (with her sister), presumably by the Mhangeni Pride (2024-07-31). Both lionesses were reported killed 'in recent months' as of that post.
offspring_labels: Nkuhuma Breakaway male and/or female (b. 2022; mother is one of the two sisters)
individuals.notes: Identity of 'Ridge Nose' vs 'Amber Eyes' as mother of the 2022 cubs is not specified.

individuals.label: Amber Eyes (Nkuhuma Breakaway lioness)
individuals.birth_note: Born around December 2012, littermate of Ridge Nose (2022-08-10; 2024-07-31)
individuals.fate: Killed in 2024, presumably by the Mhangeni Pride.
individuals.notes: Same as above.

individuals.label: Nkuhuma Breakaway Male (Plains Camp son)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; wounded the blonde Gijima Male; considered possible coalition partner for Styx Male.
individuals.notes: Plains Camp genetics evident (large frame). Went quiet after the Gijima encounter (2026-07-07). Age quoted 4 in Aug 2025 would imply birth 2021 (small inconsistency).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma Breakaway Female (Plains Camp daughter)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2022 (two cubs, 1 male + 1 female, 2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; may have helped her brother against a Gijima male (speculative).
individuals.notes: Impressively large for her age (2025-08-04).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma lioness born Dec 2012 (injured hind leg 2020)
individuals.birth_note: Born December 2012, littermate of Ridge Nose/Amber Eyes (2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: Hind-leg injury (2020) with deteriorating condition; last seen ~Jul 2022 'not looking good'; fate not stated.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Matimba Males (inferred - littermates of the two sired by Matimba)
individuals.notes: 2022-08-10 calls them 'three' Dec-2012 littermates (two + this one).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma subadults born May-Dec 2019 (7: 5 males, 2 females)
individuals.birth_note: Born between May and December 2019 (2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: By Jul 2024 'three of his sons born into the Nkuhuma Pride in 2019 have left their mothers' and accompany the surviving Northern Avoca Male (2024-07-18); others unaccounted.
